beats.text: In Japan, 30% of people are 65 or older. Zambia has only 2%.
Japan is the world's highest, counting all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
Japan has 2 times China. China stands at 15%.
The USA has 18%. Australia and Russia share that figure.
Across Europe, Italy has 25%. Germany, Greece and Finland all have 24%.
At the lowest end, Qatar has 2%, the world's lowest.
